title: Asamiya Buranji Sahityar Vislesanatamak Adhyayan (অসমীয়া বুৰঞ্জী সাহিত্যৰ বিশ্লেষণাত্মক অধ্যয়ন)
author: Dr. Uttam Chandar Pathak (ড° উত্তম চন্দৰ পাঠক)
description: An analytical scholarly study of the Buranji literature of Assam, contrasting the archaic Tai-Ahom language manuscripts (Chai-Phu, Lik-Khum-Tai) with subsequent Assamese court prose chronicles. The work analyzes historiographical methodology, chronological fidelity, and scribal lineages.
source: Guwahati: Chandra Prakash, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.451677
